description: Genistein induction of the bll6421-bll6428 operon in wild type and in nod two-component sensor mutants
code:
import requests,re,numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
open("/tmp/a.gz","wb").write(requests.get("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE8nnn/GSE8580/matrix/GSE8580_series_matrix.txt.gz",timeout=60).content)
df=pd.read_csv("/tmp/a.gz",compression="gzip",sep="\t",comment="!",low_memory=False).set_index("ID_REF")
df.index=[re.sub(r"_(at|s_at|x_at|i_at|f_at|r_at)$","",str(i)) for i in df.index]
G={"WT_gen":["GSM212687","GSM212688","GSM212689"],"WT_ctl":["GSM212690","GSM212691","GSM212692"],
   "nodW_gen":["GSM212768","GSM212769","GSM212770"],"d901_gen":["GSM212771","GSM212772","GSM212773"]}
L=np.log2(df[sum(G.values(),[])].clip(lower=1))
L=L.groupby(level=0).mean()                      # collapse duplicate probes
num=pd.Series(L.index).str.extract(r"^bl[lr](\d+)")[0]
L=L[num.notna().values].copy(); L["ord"]=num.dropna().astype(int).values; L=L.sort_values("ord")
print("unique bll/blr probes:",len(L))
OP=[f"bll{n}" for n in range(6421,6429)]
def contrast(a,b,label):
    fc=(L[G[a]].mean(axis=1)-L[G[b]].mean(axis=1)).dropna()
    op=fc.reindex(OP).dropna(); obs=op.mean(); k=len(op)
    v=fc.values; W=np.array([v[i:i+k].mean() for i in range(len(v)-k+1)])
    emp=(np.sum(W>=obs)+1)/(len(W)+1)
    nod={g:round(fc[g],1) for g in ["bll2049","bll2050","bll2051","bll2052","blr2027"] if g in fc.index}
    print("%-24s operon mean %+.3f (n=%d) empP=%.4f pct=%.1f | bll6422 %+.3f | blr6429 %+.3f | nod %s"%(
        label,obs,k,emp,stats.percentileofscore(W,obs),fc.get("bll6422",np.nan),fc.get("blr6429",np.nan),nod))
    return op,obs,emp
print()
r1=contrast("WT_gen","WT_ctl","WT +genistein")
r2=contrast("nodW_gen","WT_ctl","nodW mutant 613 +gen")
r3=contrast("d901_gen","WT_ctl","nodW nwsA d901 +gen")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.6))
labs=["wild type\n+ genistein","nodW mutant 613\n+ genistein","nodW nwsA $\\Delta$901\n+ genistein"]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.105
for i,g in enumerate(OP):
    ax.bar(x+(i-3.5)*w,[r[0].get(g,np.nan) for r in (r1,r2,r3)],width=w,
           color="#c1442e" if g=="bll6422" else "#6f9ac8")
for xx,r in zip(x,(r1,r2,r3)):
    ax.plot([xx-0.42,xx+0.42],[r[1],r[1]],color="k",lw=1.4)
    ax.text(xx,r[1]+0.10,"operon mean %+.2f, empirical P = %.3f"%(r[1],r[2]),ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=9); ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6)
ax.set_ylabel("log2 fold change vs uninduced wild type")
ax.set_title("Genistein induction of bll6421-bll6428 (red: bll6422) survives loss of the NodW and NwsA sensors\nGSE8580, n = 3 arrays per arm, bars are the eight operon genes in order",fontsize=10.5)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
